title: Buyers and Purchasing Agents, Farm Products
description: Purchase farm products either for further processing or resale. Includes tree farm contractors, grain brokers and market operators, grain buyers, and tobacco buyers. May negotiate contracts.

tasks.text: Purchase, for further processing or for resale, farm products, such as milk, grains, or Christmas trees.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Purchase research automatable; human authorizes spend

tasks.text: Negotiate contracts with farmers for the production or purchase of farm products.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Contract negotiation needs mandate and accountability

dwas.name: Negotiate contracts with clients or service providers.
dwas.gwa_name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

tasks.text: Maintain records of business transactions and product inventories, reporting data to companies or government agencies as necessary.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Enter and maintain data in information systems

dwas.name: Maintain data in information systems or databases.
Communicate with government agencies.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Review orders to determine product types and quantities required to meet demand.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Organizational calculations from given data

dwas.name: Calculate data to inform organizational operations.

tasks.text: Arrange for transportation or storage of purchased products.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Logistics coordination needs real-time human decisions

dwas.name: Coordinate logistics or other business operations.

tasks.text: Coordinate or direct activities of workers engaged in cutting, transporting, storing, or milling products and maintaining records.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Employee supervision is accountability-bearing human work

tasks.text: Arrange for processing or resale of purchased products.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Financial execution software-mediated; authorization human

dwas.name: Execute sales or other financial transactions.

tasks.text: Examine or test crops or products to estimate their value, determine their grade, or locate any evidence of disease or insect damage.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Valuation aided; human owns final value judgment

dwas.name: Determine the value of goods or services.

tasks.text: Estimate land production possibilities, surveying property and studying factors such as crop rotation history, soil fertility, or irrigation facilities.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical property inspection needs on-site sensory judgment

dwas.name: Evaluate condition of properties.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People
